spec.name: Madreperla — Italian Mother-of-Pearl Piano Accordion
spec.description: A fully extended Italian piano accordion standing upright facing the viewer, its treble case with piano keyboard and fretwork grille toward +Z, a fan of crimson-and-pearl bellows in the middle, the bass case with button field behind, all dressed in iridescent mother-of-pearl shell, abalone inlay and gold pinstripe.
spec.layout: Front view (+Z): the treble case, a pearl-shelled box 0.42 m wide, 0.40 m tall, 0.26 m deep, its front face carrying a recessed piano keyboard (18 ivory white keys with ebony sharps, abalone key cheeks) and, above it, an art-deco grille of gold fan fretwork over dark felt with an abalone medallion. Behind it the bellows stretch 0.60 m along -Z as about 15 stacked folds: each fold a pearl-white outer flange with a gold tape edge, the recessed inner flute panels in deep crimson with darker shadow between folds, the whole fan slightly narrower than the cases (0.38 m wide, 0.34 m tall, lifted 0.03 m off the floor so the two case bottoms are the feet). At the back the bass case mirrors the treble case: pearl shell box with gold pinstripes, a walnut bass-button field of 5 rows x 8 chrome-and-ivory buttons on its back face, and big abalone sunburst medallions inlaid on both outer side faces and the top. Leather shoulder straps with pearl buckles hang down the outer sides of both cases from gold anchor plates on the top edges; chrome corner guards cap every corner of both cases. The mother-of-pearl style shows everywhere: pale iridescent shell surfaces edged in gold pinstripe, abalone teal-and-rose inlays as diamonds, fans and medallions on grille, cheeks, case sides and buckle faces, chrome fittings, and crimson bellows giving the one strong colour note.

parts.builds: The front treble body of the accordion, a pearl-shelled box spanning x [-0.21, 0.21], y [0, 0.40], z [0.30, 0.56], standing on the floor (bottom rail at y = 0, a slim walnut base rail inlay around the bottom edge). Construction: main case body as a slab/box in 'pearl' with a 'pearlDeep' lower third for shading, gold pinstripe trims (thin strips in 'gold') running around all four vertical edges and along the top. FRONT FACE (+Z): a recessed keyboard shelf about 0.02 m deep, holding 18 ivory keys ('ivory', each ~0.021 m wide, ~0.115 m long, tiny 'ink' gap lines between) with ebony sharps ('ebony', ~0.011 m wide, ~0.07 m long) between groups; the key sits on a raised keybed plank in 'walnut'. Flanking the keyboard, two key cheeks (end blocks) in 'pearl' each capped with a vertical abalone inlay strip (small alternating 'abalone'/'abaloneRose' diamonds) and a 'goldBright' cap. ABOVE the keyboard a grille board (~0.40 m wide x 0.17 m tall, top edge at y = 0.40): a 'felt' dark panel behind an art-deco fretwork of gold fan shapes (three to five radiating 'gold' slats in a fan, abalone diamond at each fan's pivot), framed by a 'goldBright' border and a thin 'abalone' inner pinstripe; a small round abalone medallion (concentric rings 'abalone'/'abaloneRose'/'gold') centred on the grille. Under the grille, a slim 'gold' nameplate bar with a tiny gold lyre emblem built from small extruded slabs. Corner hardware belongs to the strapsAndHardware part, not here. All pieces as their own parts seated on the case, every surface a flat colour from the palette.
parts.attaches: Back face (z = 0.30) closes onto the bellowsFront mount [0, 0.2, 0.3] where the bellows' front fold butts against it; the strapsAndHardware part caps its four corners and hangs a strap from the strapAnchorTreble mount [0.17, 0.4, 0.42] on its top edge.

parts.builds: The extended bellows fan between the two cases, spanning x [-0.19, 0.19], y [0.03, 0.37], z [-0.30, 0.30] (0.60 m of extension, lifted 0.03 m off the floor so the case bottoms are the feet). Build 15 identical folds evenly spaced along z: each fold is an outer flange frame — a thin rectangular frame (0.38 m wide, 0.34 m tall, ~0.012 m thick) in 'pearl' with a 'pearlDeep' edge, its outer face trimmed with a thin 'gold' tape line around its perimeter — and between consecutive flanges a recessed inner flute panel (~0.026 m deep, set back toward each case) in 'bellowsRed' with a darker 'bellowsDark' bottom band so the pleats read as deep red valleys between pale pearl ridges; alternate the recess direction fold by fold so the zigzag accordion profile is real, not just painted. Small corner triangles of 'leather' where the first and last folds meet the cases (bellows gussets). The whole fan reads as a rainbow of pearl ridges over crimson valleys. Geometry as individual slabs per fold (15 folds x 2-3 pieces plus trims ~ under budget), no joints needed, static.
parts.attaches: First fold butts flat against the treble case back face at the bellowsFront mount [0, 0.2, 0.3]; last fold butts against the bass case front face at the bellowsBack mount [0, 0.2, -0.3]; leather gussets overlap both case edges slightly.

parts.builds: The rear bass body, a pearl-shelled box spanning x [-0.21, 0.21], y [0, 0.40], z [-0.56, -0.30], standing on the floor (bottom rail at y = 0, slim walnut base rail inlay). Construction mirrors the treble case: main body slab in 'pearl' with a 'pearlDeep' lower third, 'gold' pinstripes around vertical edges and the top rim. BACK FACE (-Z): a recessed walnut panel (~0.30 m wide x 0.24 m tall, centred) framed in 'goldBright', holding the bass button field: 5 rows x 8 round buttons — small cylinders in 'chrome' with 'ivory' tops, ~0.016 m diameter, standing ~0.008 m proud — plus one 'abalone' air button offset in a corner of the field. SIDE FACES (x = ±0.21): large abalone sunburst medallions — concentric rings of 'abalone', 'abaloneRose', 'abaloneDeep' and 'gold' inlay about 0.09 m across — one on each side, seated flush in a shallow 'pearlDeep' recess. TOP FACE (y = 0.40): a slim abalone diamond inlay chain running along the top ridge between the case's inner and outer edges, with a 'goldBright' edge trim. No corner hardware here (belongs to strapsAndHardware).
parts.attaches: Front face (z = -0.30) closes onto the bellowsBack mount [0, 0.2, -0.3] where the bellows' last fold butts against it; the strapsAndHardware part caps its four corners and hangs a strap from the strapAnchorBass mount [-0.17, 0.4, -0.42] on its top edge.

parts.builds: All the fitting metal and the shoulder straps, the jewellery of the instrument, spanning the whole model but touching only the case tops and outer sides. CHROME CORNER GUARDS: on each of the four vertical corners of both cases (8 corners), a chrome corner cap ('chrome') — a small angled bracket following the corner, ~0.05 m tall along each edge, with a tiny 'gold' rivet dot on each face. SHOULDER STRAPS: two leather straps hanging down the outer sides — the right strap from the strapAnchorTreble mount [0.17, 0.4, 0.42] down the +X side of the treble case, the left strap from the strapAnchorBass mount [-0.17, 0.4, -0.42] down the -X side of the bass case. Each strap: a flat leather band ('leather', ~0.035 m wide, ~0.006 m thick, ~0.30 m long) running from the anchor down the case side to about y = 0.10, edged with a thin 'goldBright' piping line; a gold anchor plate ('goldBright', small rounded plate with two 'ink' rivets) where it meets the case top; midway down, a pearl buckle — a rectangular frame in 'pearl' with an 'abalone' centre bar and a 'gold' pin; at the bottom end, a leather loop ('leatherDark') and a small 'gold' keeper ring. TOP STRAP PADS: where each strap leaves the case top, a small rounded 'leather' pad. Nothing may overlap the keyboard, grille, button field or medallions built by the other parts.
parts.attaches: Straps root at the strapAnchorTreble mount [0.17, 0.4, 0.42] on the treble case top edge and the strapAnchorBass mount [-0.17, 0.4, -0.42] on the bass case top edge, running down each case's outer side; corner guards seat on the four vertical corners of both cases at x = ±0.21, z = 0.56 and -0.56, hugging the case edges.
